self_checks.gate_criteria_frozen: PASS-A: |rho|>=0.30 AND sign_auc>=0.60 AND rho_CI_excludes_0 AND >=2 detectors same-sign AND LCO rho>=0.5*|rho|; PASS-B: correctable_auc>=0.60 OR |rank_biserial|>=0.30 AND mean LCO auc>=0.55 (PASS)

key_findings.pass_a_detail: no feature reaches |Spearman rho(delta_tau*_SAFE)|>=0.30 (max |rho|=0.203 for q99_q95_change); natural sign rules accuracy 0.37-0.53 << trivial B3 detector-only 0.79; dominant direction is LOWER threshold (82/117 negative); natural sign rule (positive shift -> raise) is WRONG for PatchCore (23/24 shift>0 -> delta_tau<0) and EfficientAD (19/24)
key_findings.pass_b_detail: median_shift AUC=0.712 (rank-biserial 0.425, mean LCO AUC 0.714), mean_shift 0.665, d_q90 0.603, wasserstein 0.645, ks 0.681, T3 0.685; per-detector median_shift AUC: DINOv2 0.617, PatchCore 0.763, EfficientAD 0.676; per-category 0.64-0.91 across 6 categories with variation (not single-category driven)
key_findings.correctability_not_fnr_proxy: AUC(fnr_before vs correctable)=0.494 (near random); correctable correlates with fpr_before (AUC 0.685, rho 0.252); median_shift discriminates correctability within high-FNR regime (AUC 0.765)
key_findings.detector_dependence_h4: correctable prevalence DINOv2 16/39, PatchCore 1/39, EfficientAD 5/39; sign patterns differ strongly by detector

caveat_for_stage_D: Direction/magnitude identifiability (H2/H3) NOT supported. Stage D actuators must be SELECTIVE (decide whether to correct) with a conservative correction; precise magnitude correction is not supported by normal-only evidence.
